programs.description: Instructional sports programs are designed to introduce sport-specific skills while improving fundamental movement with agility, balance and coordination. programs.name: Pilates
programs.description: Build core strength and improve flexibility with this head-to-toe workout. As you progress through slow-paced movements, performed in sequence, you will learn to incorporate an awareness of the spine and breath in this complete approach to well being.

programs.name: Pottery

programs.name: Pottery: Wheel

programs.name: Strength and Conditioning
programs.description: Get your muscles moving in the Strength and Conditioning class. With an emphasis on full body conditioning, exercises will target key muscle groups including arms, legs, abdominals and chest to improve you overall endurance and flexibility.

programs.name: Wood Working
programs.description: Working with wood is a wonderful way to engage your mind and use your hands. From measuring and designing to cutting and shaping, there are many skills to gain. In this introductory activity, you will learn how to safely use tools and machinery to create your own woodworking project.

programs.name: Yoga with Caregiver
programs.description: Relax your body and mind with yoga.  Learn and practice yoga poses and postures to improve your balance, breathing, flexibility and strength. A caregiver must actively participate in this activity.

programs.name: Yoga: Chair
programs.description: Gain all the benefits of yoga with the added support of a chair or your walker. Combining gentle stretches and traditional poses, you will improve your flexibility, strength, breathing and relaxation with every movement.

programs.name: Aquatic Fitness: Circuit Training
programs.description: Looking for a new  creative program? This session is for you! Discover dynamic circuit training  workouts that accommodate all fitness levels. The program is perfect for  participants seeking variety, efficiency, and results. Buoyancy and resistive  equipment will be challenge you in new, energizing ways. This format offers a  smart solution that promotes cross-training and accelerates fitness gains.  Whether you're looking to boost caloric burn, be in a fun interactive  environment, or just switch things up, circuit training provides a functional  upgrade to your experience!It is free to reserve a spot in this activity, fees may apply at the time of check in.Please arrive 10 minutes before your scheduled start time to check in with staff and pay for this swim. Your reserved spot will be held until 5 minutes prior to the class scheduled start time, after which it will be released to the walk-in line. A printed receipt or a mobile screenshot is required at check in.Participants are permitted to bring their own personal equipment.To cancel, visit your online account, speak with community centre staff, or contact Client Services at 416-396-7378 during regular business hours.

programs.name: Dance: Ballet

programs.name: Recreation Discovery
programs.description: Embark on a recreational discovery with a focus on developing skills through creative, active and interactive activities. Programming will include storytelling, theme-based games, crafts, music and physical activity, while having fun with new friends.

programs.name: Tai Chi
programs.description: Embrace the body and mind through the practice of tai chi . Learn how to pair gentle movements that you will perform in a sequence with controlled breathing, to improve your flexibility, coordination, strength and mental concentration.

programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description: Spend a day experimenting,  playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed  for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary  abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before  bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique  final artwork. No experience necessary—just  come ready to experiment and make something your own!

No experience necessary—just  come ready to experiment and make something your own!
